$schema-note: Image provenance manifest for devices/m5stack/dinmeter-v1.1. The bulk of the family's product photography is filed under devices/m5stack/dinmeter/media/ and is not duplicated here.
global_notes: Retrieved 2026-09-04. Every file returned HTTP 200 and was validated by magic bytes.

IMPORTANT: the four shop.m5stack.com images have URLs ending .webp but the Shopify CDN served JPEG bytes. They were renamed locally to .jpg so the extension matches the content. Bytes unmodified; canonical URLs recorded as served. See format_mismatch_note.
Creator/rightsholder: M5Stack Technology Co., Ltd. No individual photographer credited.
Licence UNKNOWN; redistribution status unknown; disposition repository (unstaged pending review).
No image was cropped, rotated, annotated or watermark-stripped.
Captions are generic: the files were validated and hashed but NOT visually rendered in this pass. Describing frames nobody looked at would be fabricated provenance.
Shopify URLs carry a ?v= cache-buster that is part of the URL as served; it is retained.
GAP: no teardown, bare-PCB, or v1.1-vs-v1.0 comparison photograph was found anywhere.
